# What Happened to WhiteHat Jr? A Guide for Parents


Updated on November 21, 2026


Table of Contents


What we know about WhiteHat Jr
What we don't know
First, save what you can
If you think you are owed money
Your child's learning is not lost
How to choose a new coding class
How Codingal can help your child keep going
Frequently asked questions


If your child was learning with WhiteHat Jr, you may have tried to log in recently and found nothing there. Maybe classes stopped without much warning. Maybe you are still waiting to hear back about money you paid. That is a hard spot to be in, especially if your child was enjoying their lessons.


This guide covers what we know, what we don’t know, where to go for help with payments, and how to keep your child learning. We are Codingal, an online coding school, so we will tell you at the end how we can help. Most of this page is useful whichever school you choose.


## What we know about WhiteHat Jr


WhiteHat Jr ran live online classes for children in coding, maths and music. Here is what anyone can check today:


- **March 2025:** the WhiteHat Jr website was still up and advertising free trial classes.
- **December 2025:** the website had been replaced by an unrelated “Coming Soon” page.
- **November 2026:** neither whitehatjr.com nor the student class platform opens.


## What we don’t know


We have not found an official announcement from WhiteHat Jr saying whether it has closed for good, when it stopped, or why. So we are not going to guess. If WhiteHat Jr or its owners publish a statement, that is the one to trust.


## First, save what you can


Even with the website gone, you may still have useful records in your inbox and phone.


- **Search your email and WhatsApp** for “WhiteHat Jr”. Look for certificates, links to your child’s projects, invoices and payment receipts.
- **Download or screenshot** any certificates and project links your child received.
- **Keep your payment records in one place:** receipts, bank or card statements, and any instalment or loan paperwork.


These records help if you raise a complaint. They also help your child’s next teacher see what your child has already done.


## If you think you are owed money


We can’t give advice about refunds from another company, and Codingal can’t process WhiteHat Jr refunds. These are the right places to ask:


- **In India:** the National Consumer Helpline. Call **1915** or **1800-11-4000** (toll-free, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST, every day except national holidays), send an SMS to **8800001915** , or register a complaint online at[consumerhelpline.gov.in](https://consumerhelpline.gov.in/) .
- **If you paid in instalments through a finance company:** contact that company directly about the instalments.
- **Outside India:** your country’s consumer protection body.


## Your child’s learning is not lost


A website can disappear. What your child learned does not. The habits that coding builds stay with them: breaking a big problem into small steps, testing an idea, fixing what goes wrong and trying again.


A simple way to see where your child is right now: ask them to show you something they made, or explain how they made it. If they can talk you through it, they are not starting from zero, and their next class shouldn’t treat them as if they are.


## How to choose a new coding class


If you are looking for somewhere new, these questions are worth asking any school, including us:


1. **Is there a live teacher?** If your child liked live classes, look for real teachers, not just recorded videos.
2. **Will they check my child’s level first?** Your child shouldn’t have to repeat lessons they have already done.
3. **Can we try a class for free?** Your child should meet the teacher before you pay anything.
4. **How will I see progress?** Look for progress reports, class recordings and a way to talk to the teacher.
5. **Is the refund policy written down?** Read it before you pay, not after.
6. **Do the timings fit around school?** Flexible scheduling makes it much easier to stick with.


## How Codingal can help your child keep going


Codingal runs live online[AI & coding classes for kids & teens](https://www.codingal.com/) in Grades 1 to 12. If your child’s coding stopped when WhiteHat Jr went offline, here is how we can help them carry on.


- **Start with a free trial class.** The trial is personalised. It helps us understand what your child already knows and find the right course, so they don’t have to begin again from zero.
- **Live teachers, 1:1 or in small groups.** Choose private 1:1 lessons for full attention, or group lessons if your child enjoys learning with others.
- **Courses for every stage.** Scratch, Python, game development, app development, web development, AI and Roblox. You can[see all courses here](https://www.codingal.com/courses/) . We also teach Math, Public Speaking and Creative Writing.
- **Timings that fit your family.** Pick the days and times that work around school.
- **You can see how it’s going.** Your dashboard has class recordings and progress reports, and there are monthly parent and teacher meetings.
- **Accredited certificates.** Our coding courses come with STEM.org-accredited certificates.
- **A clear refund policy.** You can read[our refund policy](https://www.codingal.com/refund-policy/) before you enrol.


Want to hear from other families first?[Read parent reviews of Codingal on Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/codingal.com) .


All your child needs is a laptop or computer with a webcam and a stable internet connection. A tablet or iPad also works with an external keyboard, a microphone and a camera.

## Frequently asked questions


### Is WhiteHat Jr still running?


As of November 2026, the WhiteHat Jr website and its student class platform do not open. We have not found an official announcement explaining what has happened.


### Can Codingal refund the money I paid to WhiteHat Jr?


No. Codingal is a separate company and can’t process WhiteHat Jr refunds. In India, you can contact the National Consumer Helpline on 1915 or 1800-11-4000, or at consumerhelpline.gov.in.


### Will my child have to start coding from the beginning again?


Not necessarily. Codingal’s free trial class is personalised to help find the right course for your child, based on what they already know.


### Is the Codingal trial class really free?


Yes. There is nothing to pay for the trial class.


### What does my child need to join a Codingal class?


A laptop or computer with a webcam and a stable internet connection. A tablet or iPad also works with an external keyboard, a microphone and a camera.


### Does Codingal teach maths as well as coding?


Yes. Alongside AI and coding, Codingal offers Math, Public Speaking and Creative Writing courses.
